rationale: BG&E Graduate Way is a two-year graduate program with mentoring, chartership support and year-round EOI for civil engineering graduates across ANZ offices including Melbourne.
Advanced Diploma Civil Construction Design (Feb 2026) plus BSCE and site coordination experience support early consulting civil work.
Full working rights to December 2027 meet typical graduate hire windows; honest limit is no Australian consulting employment yet and Bachelor completed 2019.
caution: Official March application window noted; page also invites year-round EOI via the careers site.
apply_instructions: Submit Graduate Way / EOI via https://bgeeng.com/career/early-careers/ and https://bgeeng.com/career with cover letter, CV and transcript; mention preferred Melbourne office and civil discipline.
title: Graduate Way program - civil engineering expression of interest
